editorial.blurb: La Catedral Cafe is a bright, welcoming spot on the New Eastside where excellent coffee and fresh juices pair with thoughtfully prepared breakfast fare.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early to avoid crowds and snag easy parking; ask your server for recommendations—reviewers consistently praise staff who guide you through the menu.
